title: LRUCache & TreeIndex
scenario: Build two in-memory data structures for a catalog query engine: an O(1) least-recently-used cache backed by a doubly-linked list and a Map, and a DFS/BFS tree index for hierarchical category lookup without mutating caller trees.

milestones.title: Node & Cache Contracts
milestones.goal: Define cache contracts, tree node types, CacheConfigError, and positive integer validateCapacity.

milestones.title: Doubly-Linked List Ops
milestones.goal: Implement encapsulated DoublyLinkedList keeping internal links private and maintaining head/tail/size invariants.

milestones.title: O(1) get/put Eviction
milestones.goal: Implement createLRUCache combining Map and DoublyLinkedList with isolated per-instance state.

milestones.title: Recursive DFS/BFS Tree Search
milestones.goal: Implement createTreeIndex supporting DFS lookup, BFS shallowest tag search, preorder IDs, and pathToId without mutating source trees.

review.note: Independent review passed for LAB-PRG-T01-C03-01. (1) README clearly specifies all milestone contracts, including M2 detached-handle remove/moveToFront semantics (returns false if detached or from another list; moveToFront is a no-op) and M3 put-update hit-stat behavior (hits incremented only by get hits, not put updates). Visible (6) and hidden (4) tests pass against reference and blindSolve and fail on starter stubs; M2 hidden tests verify handle encapsulation, head/tail/middle removal, repeated detached remove, cross-list rejection, popBack detachment, and reuse after empty. All four trapMutants violate their stated qualityChecks (M1 capacity validation, M2 exposed prev/next & unchecked remove, M3 module-scoped sharedIndex Map, M4 DFS instead of BFS in findFirstByTag) and are caught by their milestone tests (verified via lab_ingest --check --offline). (2) All 4 reference modules (contracts.ts, linkedList.ts, lruCache.ts, treeIndex.ts) pass ESLint and strict tsc --noEmit cleanly with zero errors/warnings, avoid input mutation (frozen tree tests pass; fresh arrays/stats returned), and isolate all mutable state per instance. (3) package.json scripts check:m1..check:m4, check:reference, and check:hidden all work as designed.
